tool_schemas.name: search_videos
tool_schemas.description: Searches YouTube (using cache when fresh, or refetching when refresh=true) for videos matching the required query, optionally constrained by region_code, channel (channel_id or youtube_channel_id), and published_after/published_before, and returns up to limit results plus a next page_token when more results are available. Results are paged with the opaque page_token from a prior response; omit page_token to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including date range), NOT_FOUND if channel_id does not exist in our cache, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller’s search/fetch budget is exhausted (especially when refresh=true triggers a YouTube fetch).

query.description: Free-text search query to send to YouTube and/or match cached results.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code used to localize search results (e.g., US, GB).

channel_id.description: Internal channel ULID to restrict results to a cached channel.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...) to restrict results to a channel.

published_after.description: Only return videos published after this timestamp.

published_before.description: Only return videos published before this timestamp.

safe_search.description: SafeSearch level to apply to search results.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of results.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache/staleness heuristics and refetch from YouTube.

tool_schemas.name: get_video_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached materialized view of a single video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id), and when refresh=true it refetches and updates our cached entity before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or an identifier fails validation, NOT_FOUND if the referenced internal video_id is unknown (or the YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access this operation, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refetch is required but the caller has no remaining fetch quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch details for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch details for.

refresh.description: If true, refetch video details from YouTube even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_channel_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed channel information resolved by youtube_channel_id, internal channel_id, or handle, using cached data when available and refetching when refresh=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if none of the identifiers are provided or handle/IDs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the internal channel_id does not exist in our cache or the handle/YouTube channel cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to access channel lookups, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when a YouTube refetch is needed but the caller has no remaining quota.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...) to fetch details for.

channel_id.description: Internal channel ULID to fetch details for.

handle.description: Channel handle (e.g., @somecreator) to resolve and fetch details for.

refresh.description: If true, refetch channel details from YouTube even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_video_comments
tool_schemas.description: Returns top-level comments for a video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id) ordered by order, optionally including replies, with up to limit items and an opaque page_token for pagination when more comments are available; refresh=true forces a refetch before returning. Pagination is driven exclusively by page_token values returned by this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or invalid paging/limit values, NOT_FOUND if the internal video_id is unknown (or the YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access comments, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if fetching/updating comments from YouTube is required but the caller is over quota (more likely with include_replies=true or refresh=true).

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch comments for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch comments for.

order.description: Ordering of comments as returned by YouTube.

limit.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of comments.

include_replies.description: If true, include replies where available (may increase fetch cost).

refresh.description: If true, refetch comments from YouTube even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_video_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Returns a video transcript/captions (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id) in the requested format (text or segments), optionally selecting language and allowing auto-generated captions; refresh=true forces re-extraction/refetch before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or unsupported format values, NOT_FOUND when the internal video_id is unknown, the video cannot be resolved, or no transcript is available under the requested language/auto-generated constraints, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access transcripts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refetch is required but the caller has exhausted transcript/fetch quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch transcript/captions for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch transcript/captions for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US).

include_auto_generated.description: If true, allow auto-generated captions when human captions are unavailable.

format.description: Return transcript as plain text or as timed segments.

refresh.description: If true, refetch transcript from source even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_related_videos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of videos related to the specified video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id), localized by optional region_code and language, with up to limit results and a next page_token when additional related items exist; refresh=true bypasses cache and refetches. Pagination uses the opaque page_token provided by a previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or invalid paging/limit values, NOT_FOUND if the internal video_id is unknown (or the seed YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access related-video discovery, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a YouTube refetch is needed but the caller is out of quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to find related videos for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to find related videos for.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to localize related video results.

language.description: Preferred relevance language for related videos (e.g., en).

limit.description: Maximum number of related videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of related videos.

refresh.description: If true, refetch related videos from YouTube even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending_videos
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current trending videos for the required region_code (optionally filtered by category_id) from cache when fresh or from YouTube when refresh=true, returning up to limit items plus a next page_token when more results are available. Results are paged using the opaque page_token returned by this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid region_code, invalid paging/limit values, or malformed category_id, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access trending lists, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refetch from YouTube is required but the caller has no remaining quota.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to fetch trending videos for (e.g., US).

category_id.description: Optional YouTube category ID to restrict trending results.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of trending results.

refresh.description: If true, refetch trending list from YouTube even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_video_enhanced_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Extracts transcripts for multiple videos (provide either youtube_video_ids or video_ids), optionally filtering by start_time_seconds/end_time_seconds, search_query, and segment_size_seconds, and returns results in the requested format (text, segments, or detailed) with optional cached video metadata; refresh=true forces refetch/re-extraction before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither list is provided, lists are empty, time bounds are invalid (including end before start), or format/segment parameters are invalid, NOT_FOUND when any referenced internal video_id is unknown or when a requested video has no transcript available under the requested language/auto-generated constraints, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access transcript extraction, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if processing requires YouTube refetches but the caller’s quota is exhausted.

youtube_video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to extract transcripts for.

video_ids.description: List of internal video ULIDs to extract transcripts for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US).

include_auto_generated.description: If true, allow auto-generated captions when human captions are unavailable.

start_time_seconds.description: If set, only include transcript content at or after this time offset.

end_time_seconds.description: If set, only include transcript content at or before this time offset.

search_query.description: If set, only include transcript segments matching this text query.

segment_size_seconds.description: If set, group transcript into segments of approximately this duration.

format.description: Output format for enhanced transcript results.

include_video_metadata.description: If true, include cached video metadata alongside transcript output.

refresh.description: If true, refetch transcripts from source even if cached.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API client identity resolved from the presented API key, including status, effective scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is deleted.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller (sent as the vendor-supported key parameter for server-to-server calls).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_me(api_key, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0248000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0248000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str): return dt
        if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(x):
        if x is None: return None
        if isinstance(x, datetime.datetime):
            return x if x.tzinfo else x.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        if not isinstance(x, str): return None
        s = x.strip()
        if s.endswith("Z"): s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
        try:
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except ValueError:
            return None
        return dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    _B32 = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
    def _gen_id(prefix):
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        tpart = ms
        out = []
        for _ in range(10):
            out.append(_B32[tpart % 32]); tpart //= 32
        rnd = int.from_bytes(os.urandom(10), "big")
        for _ in range(16):
            out.append(_B32[rnd % 32]); rnd //= 32
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(out))

    def _next_reset_boundary(dt):
        dt = dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        d = dt.date() + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        return datetime.datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _truncate_payload(obj, limit=50000):
        try:
            s = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)
        except Exception:
            return {"note": "non-serializable payload"}
        if len(s) <= limit:
            return obj
        return {"truncated": True, "chars": len(s), "preview": s[:limit]}

    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a non-empty string")

    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")

    # Authenticate by matching presented value to stored api_key_hash OR stored id (per contract: never hash-compare)
    api_key_val = api_key.strip()
    client = next((c for c in clients if c.get("api_key_hash") == api_key_val or c.get("id") == api_key_val), None)

    # Always log tool invocation (even unauthorized)
    req_id = _gen_id("ytb_req_")
    base_req = {
        "id": req_id,
        "client_id": client.get("id") if client else None,
        "tool_name": "get_me",
        "input_params": {"api_key": "***"},
        "normalized_query": None,
        "region_code": None,
        "youtube_video_id": None,
        "youtube_channel_id": None,
        "resolved_video_id": None,
        "resolved_channel_id": None,
        "response_payload": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "youtube_units_charged": 0,
        "cache_hit": True,
        "status": "received",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now),
    }
    tool_requests.append(base_req)
    base_req["status"] = "running"
    base_req["started_at"] = _iso(now)
    base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)

    if client is None:
        base_req["status"] = "failed"
        base_req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        base_req["http_status"] = 401
        base_req["error_code"] = "UNAUTHORIZED"
        base_req["error_message"] = "Invalid API key"
        base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")

    # Quota reset dynamics (get_me is still a request)
    qra = _parse_dt(client.get("quota_reset_at")) or now
    if qra <= now:
        client["requests_used_today"] = 0
        client["youtube_units_used_today"] = 0
        client["quota_reset_at"] = _iso(_next_reset_boundary(now))

    # Inactive clients rejected (and logged) per business rule
    if client.get("status") != "active":
        base_req["status"] = "failed"
        base_req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        base_req["http_status"] = 403
        base_req["error_code"] = "CLIENT_INACTIVE"
        base_req["error_message"] = "Client is not active"
        base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Client inactive", error_code="CLIENT_INACTIVE")

    # Enforce request quota; get_me charges 0 units but consumes 1 request
    ru = client.get("requests_used_today")
    qdr = client.get("quota_daily_requests")
    if not isinstance(ru, int) or ru < 0: ru = 0
    if not isinstance(qdr, int) or qdr < 0:
        base_req["status"] = "failed"
        base_req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        base_req["http_status"] = 400
        base_req["error_code"] = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        base_req["error_message"] = "Client quota configuration invalid"
        base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Client quota configuration invalid")

    if ru + 1 > qdr:
        base_req["status"] = "failed"
        base_req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        base_req["http_status"] = 429
        base_req["error_code"] = "QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
        base_req["error_message"] = "Daily request quota exceeded"
        base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily request quota exceeded", quota="quota_daily_requests")

    client["requests_used_today"] = ru + 1
    client["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    _save("api_clients.json", clients)

    body = {
        "client": {
            "id": client.get("id"),
            "name": client.get("name"),
            "status": client.get("status"),
            "quota_daily_requests": client.get("quota_daily_requests"),
            "quota_daily_youtube_units": client.get("quota_daily_youtube_units"),
            "quota_reset_at": client.get("quota_reset_at"),
            "requests_used_today": client.get("requests_used_today"),
            "youtube_units_used_today": client.get("youtube_units_used_today"),
            "created_at": client.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": client.get("updated_at"),
        },
        "scopes": ["read", "write", "admin"],
    }

    base_req["status"] = "succeeded"
    base_req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
    base_req["http_status"] = 200
    base_req["response_payload"] = _truncate_payload(body)
    base_req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
    return body

tool_schemas.name: create_api_client
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API client credential set and returns the created api_client plus the newly generated api_key (shown only once); refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields and CONFLICT if a client name is already in use when enforce_unique_name=true.

name.description: Human-friendly name for this API client.

quota_daily_requests.description: Daily request quota to enforce for this client.

quota_daily_youtube_units.description: Daily YouTube unit quota to enforce for this client.

enforce_unique_name.description: If true, reject creation when another client already uses the same name.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_client
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing API client by id (name, quotas, or status transition) and returns the updated record; refuses with NOT_FOUND when id is unknown, VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions, and FORBIDDEN when attempting to modify a deleted client.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller (must belong to an active client with permission to manage clients).

name.description: New display name for this API client.

status.description: Lifecycle state transition for the client; only transitions allowed by the api_clients lifecycle are accepted.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def update_api_client(api_key, id, name=None, quota_daily_requests=None, quota_daily_youtube_units=None, status=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0248000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0248000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str): return dt
        if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(x):
        if x is None: return None
        if isinstance(x, datetime.datetime):
            return x if x.tzinfo else x.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        if not isinstance(x, str): return None
        s = x.strip()
        if s.endswith("Z"): s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
        try:
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except ValueError:
            return None
        return dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    _B32 = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
    def _gen_id(prefix):
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        tpart = ms
        out = []
        for _ in range(10):
            out.append(_B32[tpart % 32]); tpart //= 32
        rnd = int.from_bytes(os.urandom(10), "big")
        for _ in range(16):
            out.append(_B32[rnd % 32]); rnd //= 32
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(out))

    def _next_reset_boundary(dt):
        dt = dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        d = dt.date() + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        return datetime.datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _truncate_payload(obj, limit=50000):
        try:
            s = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)
        except Exception:
            return {"note": "non-serializable payload"}
        if len(s) <= limit:
            return obj
        return {"truncated": True, "chars": len(s), "preview": s[:limit]}

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(id, str) or not re.match(r"^ytb_cli_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "id must match ^ytb_cli_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$")
    if name is not None:
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not (1 <= len(name.strip()) <= 120):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name must be a string of length 1..120")
        name = name.strip()
    if quota_daily_requests is not None:
        if not isinstance(quota_daily_requests, int) or quota_daily_requests < 0 or quota_daily_requests > 1000000:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "quota_daily_requests must be an integer between 0 and 1000000")
    if quota_daily_youtube_units is not None:
        if not isinstance(quota_daily_youtube_units, int) or quota_daily_youtube_units < 0 or quota_daily_youtube_units > 10000000:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "quota_daily_youtube_units must be an integer between 0 and 10000000")
    if status is not None and status not in ("active", "suspended", "deleted"):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "status must be one of: active, suspended, deleted")

    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")

    # Authenticate by matching api_key param to stored api_key_hash OR id (not hashing)
    caller_key = api_key.strip()
    caller = next((c for c in clients if c.get("api_key_hash") == caller_key or c.get("id") == caller_key), None)

    req_id = _gen_id("ytb_req_")
    req = {
        "id": req_id,
        "client_id": caller.get("id") if caller else None,
        "tool_name": "update_api_client",
        "input_params": {"api_key": "***", "id": id, "name": name, "quota_daily_requests": quota_daily_requests,
                         "quota_daily_youtube_units": quota_daily_youtube_units, "status": status},
        "normalized_query": None,
        "region_code": None,
        "youtube_video_id": None,
        "youtube_channel_id": None,
        "resolved_video_id": None,
        "resolved_channel_id": None,
        "response_payload": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "youtube_units_charged": 0,
        "cache_hit": True,
        "status": "received",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now),
    }
    tool_requests.append(req)
    req["status"] = "running"
    req["started_at"] = _iso(now)
    req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)

    if caller is None:
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 401
        req["error_code"] = "UNAUTHORIZED"
        req["error_message"] = "Invalid API key"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")

    # Caller must be active
    qra = _parse_dt(caller.get("quota_reset_at")) or now
    if qra <= now:
        caller["requests_used_today"] = 0
        caller["youtube_units_used_today"] = 0
        caller["quota_reset_at"] = _iso(_next_reset_boundary(now))

    if caller.get("status") != "active":
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 403
        req["error_code"] = "CLIENT_INACTIVE"
        req["error_message"] = "Client is not active"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Client inactive", error_code="CLIENT_INACTIVE")

    # Consume 1 request (0 units)
    ru = caller.get("requests_used_today")
    yu = caller.get("youtube_units_used_today")
    qdr = caller.get("quota_daily_requests")
    qdu = caller.get("quota_daily_youtube_units")
    if not isinstance(ru, int) or ru < 0: ru = 0
    if not isinstance(yu, int) or yu < 0: yu = 0
    if not isinstance(qdr, int) or qdr < 0 or not isinstance(qdu, int) or qdu < 0:
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 400
        req["error_code"] = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        req["error_message"] = "Client quota configuration invalid"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Client quota configuration invalid")
    if ru + 1 > qdr:
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 429
        req["error_code"] = "QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
        req["error_message"] = "Daily request quota exceeded"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily request quota exceeded", quota="quota_daily_requests")
    caller["requests_used_today"] = ru + 1
    caller["updated_at"] = _iso(now)

    # Find target
    target = next((c for c in clients if c.get("id") == id), None)
    if target is None:
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 404
        req["error_code"] = "NOT_FOUND"
        req["error_message"] = "Unknown api_client id"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown api_client id")

    if target.get("status") == "deleted":
        req["status"] = "failed"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 409
        req["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
        req["error_message"] = "Cannot modify a deleted client"
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Cannot modify a deleted client")

    # Apply updates
    changed = False
    if name is not None and name != target.get("name"):
        target["name"] = name
        changed = True
    if quota_daily_requests is not None and quota_daily_requests != target.get("quota_daily_requests"):
        target["quota_daily_requests"] = quota_daily_requests
        changed = True
    if quota_daily_youtube_units is not None and quota_daily_youtube_units != target.get("quota_daily_youtube_units"):
        target["quota_daily_youtube_units"] = quota_daily_youtube_units
        changed = True
    if status is not None and status != target.get("status"):
        transitions = {
            "active": ["suspended", "deleted"],
            "suspended": ["active", "deleted"],
            "deleted": [],
        }
        cur = target.get("status")
        if status not in transitions.get(cur, []):
            req["status"] = "failed"
            req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
            req["http_status"] = 400
            req["error_code"] = "INVALID_TRANSITION"
            req["error_message"] = "Illegal status transition from %s to %s" % (cur, status)
            req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
            _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
            _save("api_clients.json", clients)
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal status transition from %s to %s" % (cur, status))
        target["status"] = status
        changed = True

    if not changed:
        # Idempotent: return existing row as succeeded, but still persisted caller request usage
        _save("api_clients.json", clients)
        req["status"] = "succeeded"
        req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
        req["http_status"] = 200
        req["response_payload"] = _truncate_payload(target)
        req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return {"api_client": target}

    target["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    _save("api_clients.json", clients)

    req["status"] = "succeeded"
    req["finished_at"] = _iso(now)
    req["http_status"] = 200
    req["response_payload"] = _truncate_payload(target)
    req["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
    return {"api_client": target}

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists prior tool invocations for the authenticated client, filterable by status/tool_name/video/channel and time range, newest-first by default; returns results plus a next_page_token when more rows are available.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and scope results to its client_id.

status.description: Filter to requests in a specific lifecycle status.

tool_name.description: Filter to a specific tool name (e.g., get_video_details).

youtube_video_id.description: Filter to requests targeting a YouTube video id.

youtube_channel_id.description: Filter to requests targeting a YouTube channel id.

created_after.description: Only include requests created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of tool_requests to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a prior list_tool_requests response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight tool request by id by transitioning status from received|running to cancelled and returns the updated tool_requests row; refuses with NOT_FOUND if unknown, and CONFLICT if the request is already in a terminal state.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller; the request must belong to this client.

tool_schemas.name: set_cache_status
tool_schemas.description: Forces a cache lifecycle state transition for a cached entity (channel, video, or video_text_asset) and returns the updated record; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if the requested transition is not allowed for the entity type.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller (must be allowed to manage cache lifecycle for its organization/tenant).

entity_type.description: Type of cached entity whose status will be transitioned.

id.description: Internal ULID of the entity to transition (ytb_chn_... | ytb_vid_... | ytb_vta_...).

status.description: New lifecycle status for the entity; must be valid for the chosen entity_type and allowed by its transition rules.
